title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: Installment-Record Courtesy Point
content:
## Rule

An installment-record courtesy point applies to a Personal Loans courtesy waiver, counting the net installment payments on the loan (payments of type scheduled installment posted, less one for every payment returned whatever it was for): 36 or more give 0.2; 24 to 35 give 0.1; fewer than 24 give no point.

A point is added to the courtesy share by which the courtesy amount is taken; the courtesy share is held between zero and one.

| Net installment payments on the loan | Point |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.20 |
| 24 to 35 | 0.10 |
| fewer than 24 | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- 37 scheduled-installment payments posted over the life of the loan and 1 payment returned (an additional-principal payment): 36: 0.20.
- 25 posted and 2 returned: 23: none.
